verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents sandboxes that go to standby and resume in under 25ms 'even after weeks', so sessions persist across hours or days. Archive and unarchive, configurable expiration and TTL policies, and persistent volumes further support long-lived agent sessions. Missing for 10: documented limits on continuous active runtime for long-running processes (scale-to-zero after 5s of inactivity implies idle sessions are suspended rather than kept running), and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-day sessions.
